adjudication.depicted_input: CellWhisperer web interface showing selected cells in the Tabula Sapiens embedding and the chat/request entry box ('Type your request' / 'Send request').
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible. It visibly shows the immediate interface used to supply two actual inference inputs to the chat model: selected cells chosen in the exploration view and user free-text requests entered in the chat box. Under the atlas rules, a model box is not required when the route-specific input object or immediate interface is clearly depicted. Panel c would also support the text-question route, but the current crop already validly captures actual model inputs and does not need replacement.
